title: cienfuegosia subternata
intro: Cienfuegosia subternata, commonly known as the "Wild Balsam", is a plant species within the Malvaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and acting as a natural antiseptic. The health benefits of Cienfuegosia subternata include its ability to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
